name: Milkyway 2
source:
Three years have passed. Main character falls in love with a girl who happens to be a clerk in coffee shop "Milkyway". He gets chosen out of 1200 competitors as the first male part-time worker here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三年过去了。主人公爱上了一名少女，而她恰好是咖啡店“Milkyway”的店员。主人公从一千二百名竞争者中脱颖而出，成为店里有史以来第一名男性兼职店员。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
